note: libngspice (KiCad 10.0.6, econ-core, 2026-10-31) runs of OUR ESD decks (pcb.custom.esd_events): the rectifier, HBM 2 kV at 2.5 ms into /rect_out (d1, baseline d0) and into Net-(D1-A) (d3, baseline d2). Kept: every solver point within 50 us of the event, every 10th elsewhere, the last; the esd network's own nodes dropped. Reference for esd-1.

d0.deck:
.title Polari deck (kxc-3, from the ingested rows)
.include "diode.mod"
.tran 1u 10m

C1 /rect_out GND 100n
D1 Net-_D1-A_ /rect_out 1N4148
R1 /signal_in Net-_D1-A_ 1k
R2 /rect_out GND 100k
V1 GND /signal_in SINE(0 1.5 1k 0 0 0 0)
* esd-1: hbm at 0 V into /rect_out at 0.0025 s (pcb.custom.esd_events)
Vesdchg esd_chg 0 DC 0
Resdchg esd_chg esd_k 1
Sesdchg esd_k esd_c esd_off 0 esdsw
Cesd esd_c 0 1e-10
Sesddis esd_c esd_r esd_on 0 esdsw
Resd esd_r esd_m 1500
Vesdmeas esd_m /rect_out DC 0
Vesdon esd_on 0 PULSE(0 1 0.0025 1n 1n 1 2)
Vesdoff esd_off 0 PULSE(1 0 0.0025 1n 1n 1 2)
.model esdsw sw vt=0.5 vh=0 ron=0.01 roff=1e12
.end
